answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a bond anchored to a unique physical or computational resource, much as lantern marks a safe ledge above a reef of spoofed nodes. Colluders attempting to register many identities must independently satisfy per-identity proof-of-resource challenges, so marginal cost scales linearly with identity count. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
